name: aplomo
description: Reuse repository patterns and stop duplicate abstractions across coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Reuse patterns and stop duplicate abstractions.
interface.longDescription: Aplomo gives coding agents a bounded repository preflight, a catalog of canonical design patterns, a reuse-or-justify gate for new abstractions, and a final duplicate and validation review.
defaultPrompt: Review my implementation plan against the repository's existing architecture.
Find the existing pattern I should extend before I add this feature.
Review the current diff for architectural and testing risks.
